description.value: Foggy Bean Coffee is a family-owned small-batch specialty roastery and coffee bar housed in a beautifully repurposed historic building—the former St. Aiden's Church—perched on a hill overlooking Mt. Ozzard and Ucluelet's inner harbour. They pull shots on a La Marzocco Linea espresso machine alongside pour-over, cold brew, and batch-filter options, with a small retail section selling their own freshly roasted beans and locally-made mugs. Sitting at the doorstep of the Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, it is a natural stop for cyclists riding the wild west coast of Vancouver Island.

address.value: 1601 Peninsula Road, Unit C, Ucluelet, BC V0R 3A0
